title: @MarksEconomics: Why Is Housing So Expensive? The HOA Factor
description:
Your mortgage payment is only part of the cost of owning a U.S. condo. This explainer examines why housing is so expensive through HOA dues, special assessments, and the association’s finances. It unpacks Reventure Consulting’s October 6, 2026, headline about HOA defaults and mortgage restrictions, treating those claims as unverified rather than established national facts. The takeaway is to review the association’s financial documents alongside your own affordable monthly payment before buying. Would HOA dues or the possibility of a special assessment make you reconsider a condo purchase?

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
